source_instruction: i am looking for a low carbohydrates protein bar with package of 12 counts.
query: Ugh, I swear the community garden plot I’ve been tending to all spring is out to test me this week. I stopped by yesterday after work to water the tomato seedlings, and there was a whole family of fluffy baby bunnies camped out right next to the raised bed, munching on the edge of the lettuce starts I planted three weeks ago. I stood there for ten minutes holding my watering can, not wanting to scare them, but I also know if I let them hang around too long they’ll nibble every last green thing I’ve got growing before I even get a single salad out of the plot. I even picked up that little wire mesh fence last weekend to put around the bed, but I left it propped by my front door and forgot to haul it over, so now I’m kicking myself for dragging my feet on that little project. Hey, I’m grabbing breakfast foods right now and need to pick up those low sugar options I’ve been eyeing, y’know? Can you make sure to grab that one pack size I always get for quick weekday mornings? Don’t go over what I usually budget for these, yeah? I don’t wanna spend more than I normally do on breakfast staples, so just stick to what makes sense for my usual grocery run.
